$comment: The machine-readable command manifest of ks. One row per verb the binary dispatches; manifest_test.go fails the build if this file and the source disagree in either direction. Downstream (keepstate.ai/docs/cli and its verb-count lint) renders FROM this file and must never hand-type a verb. Rows may carry `safety` (a refusal the product makes on the customer's behalf, which the docs page renders as the safety property it is) and `budgetDefaults` (the per-tier session token budget). Both are DESCRIPTIONS OF MEASURED OR SOURCED BEHAVIOUR, and manifest_test.go fails if a row states one without saying where the number came from.

budgetDefaults.freeProvenance: measured 2026-09-09 on the released client against a disposable free-tier account (DEC-01 command gate)
budgetDefaults.paidProvenance: stated by the control plane, ctl/broker.go, and the ratified price book v1.2. NOT measured: no paid account was exercised.

commands.safety: Refuses a session that has no saved checkpoint, because killing it would destroy unsaved work, and names both ways out: `ks checkpoint <id> --stop` saves and stops it, `ks kill <id> --force` destroys it anyway.
commands.safetyMeasured: 2026-09-09, DEC-01 command gate, released client against a disposable account. The guard is enforced by the daemon, not the client, so it holds for every caller including the console.

commands.summary: run one command in the session
interactive terminal into a running session (tmux)
commands.note: relays the guest tmux over a control-plane upgrade tunnel; live resize is a v1 limitation

commands.summary: branch a checkpoint into diverging children
commands.note: paid plans only; each child is another running session
